title: Woman in Winter Coat & Headscarf, 1947 Vintage Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A clear full-length outdoor photograph of a young woman posing outside a suburban residential home with clapboard siding and window shutters. She is dressed in late-1940s cold-weather fashion featuring a belted dark overcoat, light-colored gloves, open-toe bow heels, and a tied patterned headscarf. Dated November 23, 1947, capturing postwar American domestic culture and style.
